description: Everlost is a team participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 under the “Abandoned but Not Forgotten” challenge. We aim to explore overlooked missions, forgotten discoveries, and abandoned scientific or technological artifacts. Our goal is to research the available evidence and develop a creative, accessible solution that helps people rediscover their historical and scientific significance.
summary:
EVERLOST is a digital storytelling project created using Canva that explores the forgotten traces of human exploration on the Moon and Mars. Through a documentary-style website, the project presents the story of NASA's Opportunity rover, highlighting its discoveries, achievements, and lasting contribution to our understanding of Mars.

It also features the Lunar Archive, a collection of fascinating human-made objects left behind on the Moon, including a golf ball and a family photograph. These objects reveal the human stories behind space exploration and the history of lunar missions.

EVERLOST addresses the challenge by bringing attention to the equipment and personal artifacts that remain on other worlds, turning forgotten objects into meaningful stories. It aims to make space exploration history interesting, accessible, and engaging while reminding audiences that even after missions end, their stories and discoveries remain.
details:
EVERLOST is a digital storytelling project designed to explore the forgotten traces of human exploration on the Moon and Mars. Created as an interactive-style website using Canva, it takes visitors through two major parts of space exploration history.

The first section focuses on NASA's Opportunity rover, presenting its mission, remarkable discoveries, and the story of how communication with it eventually ended. The second section, called the Lunar Archive, explores human-made objects left behind on the Moon, including a golf ball and a family photograph, revealing the personal and historical side of lunar exploration.

The project benefits audiences by making space exploration history more interesting and accessible, especially for students and younger learners. Its intended impact is to encourage curiosity about space, raise awareness of the objects left behind on other worlds, and show that even missions that have ended continue to contribute to human knowledge.

Tools and Software: Canva was used to design and develop the website, organize information, create visual layouts, and present the stories. Research and digital visual resources helped bring the historical and scientific information together. No programming languages or specialized hardware were required.

Creativity and Team Considerations: The creative approach was to present space exploration as an investigation into forgotten stories rather than simply listing mission facts. We combined scientific information, historical artifacts, documentary-style storytelling, and visual design to create an engaging experience. Our team considered scientific accuracy, historical significance, clarity, visual presentation, and accessibility when developing the project.

EVERLOST aims to remind people that the history of space exploration is not only about what humanity brought back, but also about what we left behind.
